disclosures.LEVEL_COVERAGE: DEV and CAL contain curriculum levels 0,1 only (the corpus plan declared 0-5; admission quotas fill before higher levels). HOLDOUT adds level 2; OOD is 6-7. HOLDOUT is also reported on the DEV/CAL-supported levels.
disclosures.SEALED_PRIOR_EXPOSURE: the Stage 3F.6-P.1D frozen integrity diagnostics published P(zero-cost optimal) and P(RESOURCE correct | zero-cost optimal) on HOLDOUT and OOD, which implies RESOURCE accuracy there; no other sealed policy quantity was computed before this plan
disclosures.SEED_FAMILY: NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: exactly one seed was used per partition, so seed family is confounded with partition; reported as the partition comparison
disclosures.ORACLE_FALLBACK: an episode where no member proposes uses the RANDOM_LEGAL_V1 control action
disclosures.RAW_REGRET_SCALE: raw regret and the catastrophic bar (100) come from a different corpus scale; normalized regret and accuracy are the comparable quantities
disclosures.POST_FREEZE_CODE_CORRECTION: after the freeze commit the first sealed run crashed: the shortcut audit read ID-relabel and D4-twin evidence for the RANDOM_LEGAL control, which the plan captures for deployable policies only. The control now reports ACTION_ID_ORDER and D4_TWIN as NOT_APPLICABLE (it selects by identity order by construction). No metric, threshold, rule or deployable-policy computation changed; the diff against the freeze commit is limited to that function.
disclosures.RESOURCE_VERDICT_READING: the pre-registered verdict is mechanical. REASONING_BEYOND_COST_PRIOR compares RESOURCE with CHEAPEST_CLASS_UNIFORM, while shortcut.<partition>.RESOURCE_PRESERVING_V1.nuisance.ACTION_ID_ORDER.permutedMeanAccuracy is the same policy with its identity tie-break randomised; when those two agree, the whole excess over the cost prior is carried by the identity tie-break (chosenDirectionShare shows it is a fixed absolute MOVE direction), not by resource reasoning.
disclosures.PREDECESSOR_STAGE3F5_STAGE3F6: Stage 3F.5 (documented SUPERSEDED by 3F.6-R) and Stage 3F.6 prediction reliability do not reproduce on --check because 3F.6-R changed the runtime they certified; Stage 3F.6 has no erratum. Neither is an input to this stage.
